ex.t: 自2011年以来，该国种植的玉米____61____（grow）超过了水稻。

ex.s: Understanding ideas (two pictures) (picture 1) Zhuang people (picture 2) Yao people Longji Rice Terraces 1 Imagine mountains wrapped in silver water, shining in the spring sun.
ex.t: 理解思路：想象群山被银色的水包裹，在春天的阳光下闪闪发光。

ex.s: Summer sees the mountains turn bright green with growing rice.
ex.t: 夏季，这些山随着水稻的生长变成明亮的绿色。

ex.s: These are the colours of the Longji Rice Terraces.
ex.t: 这些是龙脊梯田的颜色。

ex.s: Building the terraces therefore meant that they could increase the areas in which they could grow rice.
ex.t: 因此，修建梯田意味着他们可以增加种植水稻的面积。

ex.s: Today, the Longji Rice Terraces attract thousands of visitors who come to admire this great wonder created by people and nature working together.
ex.t: 如今，龙脊梯田吸引成千上万游客前来欣赏人与自然共同创造的这一伟大奇迹。
